title: Zesty Middle Eastern Lamb Kebabs
description: A quick and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb, capers, and caramelized onions, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kazan cauldron over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onions to the cauldron and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the chopped capers, lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and black pepper to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or quinoa.
Garnish with additional capers and sumac, if desired.
